title: Mining sandbox game inspired from Terraria, Factorio and Growtopia
author: NitroNightmare1987
selftext:
in this game you mostly break, smelt ores, sell worlds to profit but there's more than that, you can build, farm fruits, vegetables and animals, i made this for myself but then i added multiplayer and lots of more customization for the player and worlds, there is automation for almost everything and you can purchase new worlds to explore new ores or you can go other people's world to see what they are up to! It is called Dante's Mine, it is ready but i just need servers   
[https://mertf.itch.io/dantes-mine](https://mertf.itch.io/dantes-mine)
